color.statusBarPullForeground.descriptio: Status bar text color when incoming commits are available (pull needed)
color.statusBarPushForeground.descriptio: Status bar text color when there are unpushed commits or the branch is not on remote

config.section.basicSettings.title: Basic Settings
config.graphMaxCommits.description: Maximum commits to load in the Log Panel graph. Scrolling stops paging in more once this many are loaded.
config.showUncommittedChangesInLog.descr: Show a row for uncommitted changes (staged, unstaged and untracked files) at the top of the Log Panel graph
config.gitLog.showAuthor.description: Show the author's name in each row of the Log Panel commit list (when the list is wide enough).
config.gitLog.showAuthorAvatar.descripti: Show the author's avatar in each row of the Log Panel commit list.
config.gitLog.showDate.description: Show the commit date in each row of the Log Panel commit list.
config.gitLog.showHash.description: Show the short commit hash in each row of the Log Panel commit list.
config.gitLog.showInlineBranches.descrip: Show branch, tag and stash badges next to the commits they point to in the Log Panel commit list.
config.repositoryScanMaxDepth.descriptio: Maximum depth of workspace subfolders to scan for Git repositories (0 = only workspace folders).
config.repositoryScanIgnoredFolders.desc: Folder names or workspace-relative paths to skip while scanning for nested Git repositories.
config.submoduleMaxDepth.description: Maximum nesting depth of Git submodules shown as repositories (1 = only direct submodules, 0 = none). Lower it in large workspaces with many nested submodules to reduce Git work on every refresh.
config.branchNameModels.description: Branch name prefixes suggested when creating a new branch (e.g. "feature/", "bugfix/", "revert-"). Stored normalized with a trailing "*" (e.g. "feature/*"); entries already containing a wildcard (e.g. "feature/**") are kept as-is.
config.fetchOnStartup.description: Automatically fetch all remotes when the extension activates
config.notifyOnIncomingCommits.descripti: Show a notification on startup when there are incoming commits available to pull
config.notifyOnUnpushedCommits.descripti: Show a notification on startup when there are unpushed commits ready to push
config.notifyOnOrphanBranches.descriptio: Show a notification after fetching when local branches have lost their remote (upstream deleted, e.g. after a PR merge)
config.showLastCommitInBranchMenu.descri: Show each branch's or tag's last commit (hash, author, message, relative time) in the branch and tag menus
config.projectColors.description: Map of workspace folder/repository name to hex color for the commit graph (e.g. {"my-repo": "#ff6b6b"})
config.autoRefreshInterval.description: Auto-refresh interval in seconds (0 = disabled, use file watchers only)
config.gitAnnotations.enabled.descriptio: Enable Git Annotations in the editor.
config.gitGhostText.enabled.description: Enable inline Git ghost text in the editor.
config.avatars.enabled.markdownDescripti: Show author avatars, taken from the forges: from the repository's own GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Gitea when it is connected (the forge already holds the commits and their authors), and from GitHub, GitLab and Codeberg noreply addresses. No email address is sent to third parties. Authors without one show their initials.
config.avatars.gravatar.enabled.markdown: When no forge has an avatar for an author, look it up on Gravatar. **Privacy:** this sends a hash of the author's email to gravatar.com, which can reveal the address. Leave disabled for private or company repositories. Requires `#gitcharm.avatars.enabled#`.
config.gitLogDefaultLocation.description: Where the Log Panel opens by default: bottom panel, editor tab, or a new window.
config.gitLogDefaultLocation.enum.panel: Open the GitCharm Log in the bottom panel, next to the terminal
config.gitLogDefaultLocation.enum.editor: Open the GitCharm Log as an editor tab
config.gitLogDefaultLocation.enum.newWin: Open the GitCharm Log in a separate window
config.gitLogDefaultLayout.description: What the Log Panel shows when opened outside the bottom panel.
config.gitLogDefaultLayout.enum.logAndCo: Show the Log Panel and the Commit panel side by side
config.changesViewMode.description: How to display changed files in the Changes tab.
config.changesViewMode.enum.simplified: Show Staged and Unstaged sections per repository (default behavior)
config.changesViewMode.enum.changelists: Show files grouped by Changelists, similar to PhpStorm
config.changesViewMode.enum.vscode: Show Staged Changes / Changes sections like native VS Code, with inline stage/unstage buttons
config.promptAddUntrackedToGit.descripti: Show a prompt when new untracked files are detected, offering to add them to Git.
config.commitPanel.showShelfTab.descript: Show the Shelf tab in the Commit Panel.
config.commitPanel.showStashTab.descript: Show the Stash tab in the Commit Panel.
config.commitPanel.showWorktreesTab.desc: Show the Worktrees tab in the Commit Panel.
config.commitPanel.showPullRequestsTab.d: Show the Pull Requests tab in the Commit Panel.
config.commitPanel.showIssuesTab.descrip: Show the Issues tab in the Commit Panel.
config.commitPanel.showSyncTab.descripti: Show the Sync tab (commits to push and to pull) in the Commit Panel.
config.commitPanel.tabOrder.description: The order of the Commit Panel's tabs. Tabs left out of the list keep their place at the end; hidden tabs stay hidden.
config.commitPanel.defaultTab.descriptio: The tab the Commit Panel opens on. A hidden tab falls back to the first one.
config.commitPanel.defaultTab.changes: Open on the tab with the commit form (Changes, or Commit with changelists).
config.commitPanel.defaultTab.pullReques: Open on the Pull Requests tab.
config.commitPanel.defaultTab.lastUsed: Open on the tab last used in this workspace.
config.commitPanel.tabLabels.description: Which tabs show their name next to the icon. When the names don't fit, the tabs become a dropdown either way.
config.commitPanel.showChangesBadge.desc: Show the number of changed files on the Changes tab.
config.commitPanel.showShelfBadge.descri: Show the number of shelved changes on the Shelf tab.
config.commitPanel.showStashBadge.descri: Show the number of stashes on the Stash tab.
config.commitPanel.showWorktreesBadge.de: Show the number of linked worktrees on the Worktrees tab.
config.commitPanel.showSyncBadge.descrip: Show the number of commits to push and to pull on the Sync tab.
config.commitPanel.showPullRequestsBadge: Show the number of pull requests on the Pull Requests tab.
config.commitPanel.showIssuesBadge.descr: Show the number of issues on the Issues tab.
Show the number of changed files on GitCharm's icon in the activity bar.
config.defaultCommitAction.description: Default action for the commit button in the Commit Panel.
config.defaultCommitAction.enum.commit: The main button commits without pushing
config.defaultCommitAction.enum.commitAn: The main button commits and pushes immediately
config.defaultSaveAction.description: Default action for the Save button in the Commit Panel.
config.defaultSaveAction.enum.stash: The main Save button stashes selected changes
config.defaultSaveAction.enum.shelve: The main Save button shelves selected changes
config.openCommitPanelOnConflictResolved: Automatically open the GitCharm sidebar when a merge conflict is resolved. Matches VS Code Source Control, which opens after completing a merge.
config.suppressDivergedBranchWarning.des: Suppress the 'Branches have diverged' warning in the Git Menu and status bar.
config.section.aiSettings.title: AI Settings
config.ai.enabled.description: Enable AI features in GitCharm (commit message generation, commit explanation). When disabled, all AI actions are hidden.
config.ai.language.markdownDescription: Language for AI-generated text (e.g. `en`, `it`, `fr`, `de`). Leave empty to use the VS Code display language.
config.ai.provider.description: AI provider to use for all AI features.
config.ai.provider.enum.vscode-lm: Use VS Code Language Model API (GitHub Copilot or any registered LM extension)
config.ai.provider.enum.claude-api: Use Anthropic API directly (requires API key)
config.ai.provider.enum.openai-api: Use OpenAI API directly (requires API key)
config.ai.provider.enum.gemini-api: Use Google Gemini API directly (requires API key)
config.ai.provider.enum.ollama: Use a local Ollama model via HTTP API
config.ai.provider.enum.lmstudio: Use a local LM Studio model via HTTP API
config.ai.modelId.description: VS Code LM model ID (e.g. 'copilot:gpt-4o'). Only used when provider is 'vscode-lm'. Leave empty to auto-select. Use the 'GitCharm: Select AI Model' command to pick interactively.
config.ai.claudeApiKey.description: Anthropic API key. Only used when provider is 'claude-api'. Get your key at console.anthropic.com.
config.ai.claudeModel.description: Claude model ID (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-sonnet-4-6'). Used when provider is 'claude-api' or 'claude-cli'. Leave empty to use the default. Use the 'GitCharm: Select AI Model' command to pick interactively.
config.ai.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude CLI binary. Only used when provider is 'claude-cli'. Defaults to 'claude' (must be on PATH).
config.ai.openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key. Only used when provider is 'openai-api'. Get your key at platform.openai.com.
config.ai.openaiModel.description: OpenAI model ID (e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'gpt-4o-mini', 'o3'). Only used when provider is 'openai-api'.
config.ai.geminiApiKey.description: Google Gemini API key. Only used when provider is 'gemini-api'. Get your key at aistudio.google.com.
config.ai.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Stored in secure storage now. Set it on the **AI** page of **GitCharm: Settings**; a key entered here is moved there automatically.
config.ai.geminiModel.description: Gemini model ID (e.g. 'gemini-2.0-flash', 'gemini-2.5-pro'). Used when provider is 'gemini-api' or 'gemini-cli'.
config.ai.geminiPath.description: Path to the Gemini CLI binary. Only used when provider is 'gemini-cli'. Defaults to 'gemini' (must be on PATH).
config.ai.codexModel.description: Codex model ID to use (e.g. 'o3', 'o4-mini'). Only used when provider is 'codex-cli'. Leave empty to use the CLI default. Use the 'GitCharm: Select AI Model' command to pick interactively.
config.ai.codexPath.description: Path to the Codex CLI binary. Only used when provider is 'codex-cli'. Defaults to 'codex' (must be on PATH).
config.ai.lmStudioModel.description: LM Studio model identifier. Only used when provider is 'lmstudio'. Leave empty to use the currently loaded model. Use the 'GitCharm: Select AI Model' command to pick interactively.
config.ai.lmStudioUrl.description: Base URL of the LM Studio local server. Only used when provider is 'lmstudio'.
config.ai.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model name (e.g. 'llama3', 'mistral', 'qwen3.5:9b'). Only used when provider is 'ollama'.
config.ai.ollamaUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama API. Only used when provider is 'ollama'.
config.ai.maxDiffChars.description: Maximum characters of git diff to send to the AI model. Larger values give more context but consume more tokens.
config.ai.prompts.commitMessage.markdown: Custom AI instructions for generating the commit message. Leave empty to use the built-in default. `{language}` is replaced with the configured language; the changes (diff, files, commits…) are always appended after these instructions. Run **GitCharm: Customize AI Prompts** to start editing from the default text.
config.ai.prompts.pullRequestTitle.markd: Custom AI instructions for generating the pull request title. Leave empty to use the built-in default. `{language}` is replaced with the configured language; the changes (diff, files, commits…) are always appended after these instructions. Run **GitCharm: Customize AI Prompts** to start editing from the default text.
config.ai.prompts.pullRequestDescription: Custom AI instructions for generating the pull request description. Leave empty to use the built-in default. `{language}` is replaced with the configured language; the changes (diff, files, commits…) are always appended after these instructions. Run **GitCharm: Customize AI Prompts** to start editing from the default text.
config.ai.prompts.explainCommit.markdown: Custom AI instructions for generating the commit explanation ("Explain with AI"). Leave empty to use the built-in default. `{language}` is replaced with the configured language; the changes (diff, files, commits…) are always appended after these instructions. Run **GitCharm: Customize AI Prompts** to start editing from the default text.
config.ai.prompts.explainPullRequest.mar: Custom AI instructions for generating the pull request explanation ("Explain with AI"). Leave empty to use the built-in default. `{language}` is replaced with the configured language; the changes (diff, files, commits…) are always appended after these instructions. Run **GitCharm: Customize AI Prompts** to start editing from the default text.
config.section.pullRequests.title: Pull Requests
config.section.issues.title: Issues
config.pullRequests.hostProviderOverride: Manual forge-type override per Git host for self-hosted instances that can't be auto-detected, e.g. { "git.mycompany.com": "gitea" }. Valid values: github, gitlab, bitbucket, gitea.
Default target branch for new pull requests when the repo's default branch can't be determined from the forge API (leave empty to auto-detect main/master).
config.pullRequests.defaultMergeStrategy: Default strategy pre-selected on the "Merge pull request" button in the Pull Request Detail panel. Falls back to the first strategy the forge/provider actually supports if this one isn't available for a given PR.
config.pullRequests.defaultCheckoutActio: Default action for the main "Checkout" button in the Pull Request Detail panel — the other option is still available from its dropdown.
Checkout Pull Request (creates/updates a local pr/{author}/{number} branch)
Checkout Branch (downloads or updates the PR's actual source branch)
config.section.experimental.title: Experimental
config.resetViewLocationsOnStartup.descr: Run VS Code's 'Reset View Locations' action on startup. Useful to clear stale GitCharm badge placement, but it resets view positions globally.
command.interactiveRebase.title: Interactive Rebase...
command.resolveConflictsWithAi.title: Resolve Conflicts with AI
command.resolveAllConflictsWithAi.title: Resolve All Conflicts with AI
command.resolveConflictHunkWithAi.title: Resolve This Conflict with AI
config.ai.operationModels.markdownDescri: Provider and model for each AI operation, in place of `#gitcharm.ai.provider#` and that provider's model. An operation left out uses them. Example: `{ "resolveConflicts": { "provider": "claude-api", "model": "claude-opus-4-7" } }`. Easier to set from **GitCharm: Settings** → AI.
config.ai.offerConflictResolution.descri: When a merge, rebase, pull or other git operation leaves conflicts, offer to resolve them with AI.
config.ai.prompts.resolveConflicts.markd: Custom AI instructions for resolving a merge conflict. Leave empty to use the built-in default. `{language}` is replaced with the configured language; the conflict (both sides, the common ancestor when known, and the surrounding lines) is always appended after these instructions.
config.ai.prompts.issueBranchName.markdo: Custom AI instructions for suggesting a branch name for an issue ("Create Branch with AI", and the branch of "Resolve with AI"). Leave empty to use the built-in default. `{language}` is replaced with the configured language; the issue and the branch prefixes in use are always appended after these instructions.
config.ai.prompts.explainIssue.markdownD: Custom AI instructions for explaining an issue. Leave empty to use the built-in default. `{language}` is replaced with the configured language; the issue, its discussion and its linked pull requests are always appended after these instructions.
config.ai.prompts.resolveIssue.markdownD: Custom AI instructions for "Resolve with AI" — how the model should work out the fix of an issue. Leave empty to use the built-in default. `{language}` is replaced with the configured language; the issue, the repository files (or, for Claude Code and Codex, how to work in the repository) and the expected answer format are always appended after these instructions.
config.protectedBranches.markdownDescrip: Branches GitCharm guards, e.g. `main` or `release/*` (`*` matches anything). Committing or pushing to one asks first; force-pushing to one is refused.
config.confirm.discardChanges.descriptio: Ask before discarding changes or deleting files and folders from the Commit Panel.
config.confirm.dropStashesAndShelves.des: Ask before dropping a stash or deleting a shelf.
config.confirm.commitOperations.descript: Ask before reverting, dropping or undoing commits.
config.autoFetchInterval.description: Fetch from every remote every this many minutes, while VS Code is focused. 0 turns it off. New incoming commits are notified as at startup.
config.fetchPrune.description: Remove remote-tracking branches that no longer exist on the remote when fetching.
config.pullMode.ask: Ask whether to merge or rebase where GitCharm offers the choice; merge elsewhere.
config.pullMode.rebase: Rebase the current branch onto the incoming changes.
config.pullMode.ffOnly: Only fast-forward: refuse to pull when the branch has diverged.
config.commitSignoff.description: Add a Signed-off-by line to every commit (git commit --signoff).
config.commitPanel.subjectMaxLength.desc: Warn when the commit message's first line is longer than this many characters. 0 turns the warning off.
config.dateFormat.description: How dates are shown in the Log Panel, the Commit Panel and pull requests. Takes effect after reloading the window.
config.dateFormat.auto: Each view's own style: absolute in the Log Panel, relative elsewhere for recent dates.
config.statusBar.showBranch.description: Show the current branch (the Git Menu) in the status bar. The Git Menu stays available from the Command Palette.
config.statusBar.showProfile.description: Show the Git profile in use in the status bar. Profiles stay manageable from the Command Palette.
config.pullRequests.defaultFilter.descri: The filter each repository's pull request list starts with, until changed for that repository.
config.pullRequests.defaultFilter.assign: Open pull requests assigned to me.
config.pullRequests.defaultFilter.review: Open pull requests awaiting my review.
Refresh the pull request list every this many minutes, while its tab is open and VS Code is focused. 0 turns it off.
config.issues.defaultFilter.description: The filter each repository's issue list starts with, until changed for that repository.
config.issues.defaultFilter.mentioningMe: Open issues mentioning me (GitHub and Gitea).
config.issues.autoRefreshInterval.descri: Refresh the issue list every this many minutes, while its tab is open and VS Code is focused. 0 turns it off.
config.issues.branchNameTemplate.markdow: The name suggested for a branch created from an issue. `{number}` is the issue number, `{title}` its title in lowercase with hyphens, `{user}` your username on the forge — e.g. `feature/{number}-{title}`. The name can still be edited before the branch is created.
config.issues.commitReferenceTemplate.ma: The text inserted into the commit message when referencing an issue. `{number}` is the issue number, `{title}` its title — e.g. `Fixes #{number}` to close the issue when the commit reaches the default branch.
